instruction: An intimate, candid portrait photograph in a close-up shot captures a tender moment in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain light gray background. On the right, the curly blonde-haired man in a gray long-sleeved shirt (R1) leans down, wrapping his arm around the shoulder of the long-haired person in a green shirt (R2) on the left. The curly blonde-haired man (R1) gently kisses the forehead of the long-haired person (R2), who rests their head against his chest with eyes closed and a peaceful expression. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a warm, gentle atmosphere with a neutral color palette.
